articles.summary: ESS Tech, Inc. (NYSE: GWH) ("ESS" or the "Company"), a leading manufacturer of long-duration iron flow energy storage systems (“LDES”) for commercial and utility-scale applications, today announced the successful commissioning of two ESS iron flow battery systems at Turlock Irrigation District ("TID") in California’s Central Valley.
articles.title: ESS Announces Successful Commissioning of Long-Duration Iron Flow Battery Systems at Turlock Irrigation District Solar-Over-Canal Project

articles.summary: ESS’ Chief Executive Officer, Drew Buckley, will participate in one-on-one investor meetings and will also host a presentation from 2:30 PM ET to 3:00 PM ET in Track 1.
